 惩戒

 神圣

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protection
After casting Divine Toll, you instantly cast Avenger's Shield every 5 sec for 15 sec.

 Retribution
After casting Divine Toll, you instantly cast Judgment every 5 sec for 15 sec.

 Holy
After casting Holy Prism, Holy Armament, or Divine Toll, you instantly cast Holy Shock every 5 sec for 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:

正义盾击额外提供5%的护甲加成，持续4.5秒。

 神圣,  惩戒
荣耀圣令额外提供20%的护甲加成，持续4.5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protection

 Holy,  Retribution
Word of Glory grants 20% bonus armor for 4.5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 净化一个友方目标，移除所有中毒效果和疾病效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的奉献的影响范围扩大15%，且会使范围内的敌人移动速度降低50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Consecration is 15% larger, and enemies within it have 50% reduced movement speed.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律效果，持续30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 向四面八方发出耀眼的光芒，使10码范围内的敌人暂时失明，并使其迷惑地游荡，持续6秒。伤害可能取消该效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yds, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 学习专注光环、虔诚光环和十字军光环：
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Learn Concentration Aura, Devotion Aura, and Crusader Aura:

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣,  惩戒
审判使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能对目标造成的伤害提高20%。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

 防护
审判使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能对目标造成的伤害提高50%。

多次施加可以重叠生效。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy,  Retribution
Judgment causes the target to take 20% increased damage from your next Holy Power ability.

Multiple applications may overlap.

 Protection
Judgment causes the target to take 50% increased damage from your next Holy Power ability.

Multiple applications may overlap.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 打断施法并使该系法术在5秒内无法施放。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 神圣马驹现在可使用2次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Divine Steed now has 2 charges.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 牺牲祝福的冷却时间缩短60秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Sacrifice by 60 sec.

处于自律效果时仍可施放圣盾术。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Removing harmful effects with Divine Shield heals you for 10% for each effect removed.  This heal cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Divine Shield may now be cast while Forbearance is active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 护甲和爆击几率提高4%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Armor and critical strike chance increased by 4%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其所受伤害降低30%，降低伤害的100%由你来承担。

持续12秒，或直到转移的伤害使你的生命值降至20%以下为止。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.

Last 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的圣盾术、 [复仇之盾: 复仇之盾、] [炽热防御者 / 圣佑术]和圣疗术的冷却时间缩短30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, [Shield of Vengeance: Shield of Vengeance] [Ardent Defender / Divine Protection], and Lay on Hands by 30%.

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律，持续30秒。

 防护
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫所有物理伤害和有害效果，持续10秒。

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律，持续30秒。

与破咒祝福共享冷却时间。

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

 Protection
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to Physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Spellwarding.

Holy

 Protection,  Retribution

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Leap atop your Charger for 3 sec, increasing movement speed by 100%. Usable while indoors or in combat.

神圣,  惩戒
护甲提高10%，耐力提高5%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低3%。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:

 Holy

 Protection

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 自由祝福使移动速度提高30%，并使你在对一名友方目标施放自由祝福时获得自由祝福。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blessing of Freedom increases movement speed by 30%, and you gain Blessing of Freedom when cast on a friendly target.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: [Denounce / Shield of the Righteous] heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for (125% of Attack Power).

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 愤怒之锤的伤害会随目标的生命值而提高，至多造成50%的额外伤害。目标生命值越低，受到的伤害越高。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗神圣能量的技能有15%的几率会使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能不消耗资源，并且伤害和治疗效果提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Holy Power spending abilities have a 15% chance to make your next Holy Power spending ability free and deal 15% increased damage and healing.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 牺牲祝福现在会移除并防止所有中毒和疾病效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blessing of Sacrifice now removes and prevents all Poison and Disease effects.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫任何移动限制效果， [无拘自由: 并使其移动速度提高30%，]持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects [Unbound Freedom: and increasing movement speed by 30%]for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 圣疗术使目标的护甲值提高30%，持续8秒，且现在会忽视治疗降低效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Lay on Hands grants the target 30% increased armor for 8 sec and now ignores healing reduction effects.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy,  Protection
Instantly cast Holy Shock, Avenger's Shield, or Judgment on up to 5 targets within 30 yds.

 Retribution
Instantly cast Judgment on up to 5 targets within 30 yds.

Divine Toll's Judgment deals 50% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
当你的生命值降低到25%以下时，立即对自己施放一次免费的荣耀圣令，效果为原来的60%。

每60秒最多触发一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
When your health is brought below 25%, you instantly cast a free Word of Glory at 60% effectiveness on yourself.

Cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 投掷出一柄祝福之锤，沿螺旋线向外飞出，对敌人造成([32.5% of Attack Power])点神圣伤害并使其下一次对你造成的伤害降低(攻击强度 * 30 / 100)点。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Throws a Blessed Hammer that spirals outward, dealing (32.5% of Attack Power) Holy damage to enemies and reducing the next damage they deal to you by (Attack Power * 30 / 100).

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 愤怒之锤和审判造成的伤害提高10%，并会使 [回响: 征伐] [复仇十字军] [戒卫 / 复仇之怒]的持续时间延长0.5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Hammer of Wrath and Judgment deal 10% additional damage and extend the duration of [Echo: Crusade] [Avenging Crusader] [Sentinel / Avenging Wrath] by 0.5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 复仇者之盾会额外跳向2个目标。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Avenger's Shield jumps to 2 additional targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 复仇之怒和戒卫的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Avenging Wrath and Sentinel have 50% reduced cooldown and 40% reduced duration.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你承受的所有伤害降低30%，持续12秒。

炽热防御者激活时，下一次原本会杀死你的攻击反而会治疗你，使你获得20%的最大生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Reduces all damage you take by 30% for 12 sec.

While Ardent Defender is active, the next attack that would otherwise kill you will instead bring you to 20% of your maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣,  防护
召唤圣光之力，成为惩戒的化身，[审判额外产生1层神圣能量，][每花费一层神圣能量，你就会使圣光爆发，对附近的敌人造成([13.5% of Attack Power])点伤害，]你的伤害、治疗效果和爆击几率提高20%，持续20秒 / 神圣愤怒: 24秒 / 正义召唤: 15秒。

 惩戒
召唤圣光之力，成为惩戒的化身，[审判额外产生4层神圣能量，][每花费一层神圣能量，你就会使圣光爆发，对附近的敌人造成([13.5% of Attack Power])点伤害，]你的伤害、治疗效果和爆击几率提高15%，持续20秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy,  Protection
Call upon the Light to become an avatar of retribution, [causing Judgment to generate 1 additional Holy Power,][each Holy Power spent causing you to explode with Holy light for (13.5% of Attack Power) damage to nearby enemies,]increasing your damage, healing, and critical strike chance by 20% for 20 sec / Divine Wrath: 24 sec / Call of the Righteous: 15 sec.

 Retribution
Call upon the Light to become an avatar of retribution, [causing Judgment to generate 4 additional Holy Power,][each Holy Power spent causing you to explode with Holy light for (13.5% of Attack Power) damage to nearby enemies,]increasing your damage, healing, and critical strike chance by 15% for 20 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
复仇者之盾每击中一个敌人，就会使远古列王守卫剩余的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

当你的生命值降至30%以下时，你会受到远古列王守卫的护持，持续4秒。此效果在45秒内不能再次触发。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Each enemy hit by Avenger's Shield reduces the remaining cooldown on Guardian of Ancient Kings by 1.0 sec.

When you drop below 30% health, you become infused with Guardian of Ancient Kings for 4 sec. This cannot occur again for 45 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 奉献会为你恢复生命值，相当于其造成伤害的375%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Consecration heals you for 375% of the damage it deals.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 被复仇者之盾击中的敌人会被神圣之火灼烧，在5秒内额外受到100%的光辉伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Enemies struck by Avenger's Shield burn with holy fire, suffering 100% additional Radiant damage over 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你躲过一次近战攻击或使用 [正义之锤] [祝福之锤 / 十字军打击]时，有15%的几率刷新复仇者之盾剩余的冷却时间 [激励勇士: 并使你的力量提高2%，持续8秒。 / 。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you avoid a melee attack or use [Hammer of the Righteous] [Blessed Hammer / Crusader Strike], you have a 15% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Avenger's Shield [Inspiring Vanguard: and increase your Strength by 2% for 8 sec / .]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每施放3次正义盾击，你的下一个荣耀圣令就不会消耗神圣能量。最多叠加2层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Every 3 Shields of the Righteous make your next Word of Glory cost no Holy Power. Maximum 2 stacks.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你被远古列王的灵魂赋予了力量，受到的所有伤害降低50%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Empowers you with the spirit of ancient kings, reducing all damage you take by 50% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 复仇者之盾每击中一个目标，你的下一个正义盾击造成的伤害就会提高10%，最多可叠加5次，同时还会使正义盾击的范围扩大6码。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Avenger's Shield increases the damage of your next Shield of the Righteous by 10% for each target hit by Avenger's Shield, stacking up to 5 times, and increases its radius by 6 yds.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 精炼圣火造成伤害时，会为你提供相当于其伤害至少125%的治疗。随生命值降低，最高可达300%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You are healed for at least 125% of the damage dealt by Refining Fire, increasing to a maximum of 300% as your health decreases.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 复仇者之盾每命中一个目标，就获得3%的招架，持续15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: For each target hit by Avenger's Shield, gain 3% parry for 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 基于你损失的生命值，正义盾击提供的护甲值提高最多60%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Armor granted by Shield of the Righteous is increased by up to 60%, based on your missing health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
召唤圣光，获得15层神圣决心，每层使你的最大生命值提高1%，并使你受到的伤害降低2%，持续20秒。5.0秒后，开始每秒失去1层，但每消耗3点神圣能量可使下一层的损失推迟1秒。

激活时，你的伤害和治疗效果提高10%，爆击几率提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Call upon the Light and gain 15 stacks of Divine Resolve, increasing your maximum health by 1% and reducing your damage taken by 2% per stack for 20 sec. After 5.0 sec, you will begin to lose 1 stack per second, but each 3 Holy Power spent will delay the loss of your next stack by 1 sec.

While active, your damage and healing are increased by 10%, and critical strike chance is increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 复仇者之盾为你提供吸收护盾，吸收的伤害量相当于其造成伤害的75%，最多吸收50%的最大生命值，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Avenger's Shield also shields you for 8 sec, absorbing 75% as much damage as it dealt, up to 50% of your maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 施放复仇者之盾会使奉献立即再次造成伤害和治疗，效果为100%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Casting Avenger's Shield causes Consecration to deal its damage and healing again immediately at 100% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将你的盾牌扔向一名敌方目标，造成([200% of Attack Power])点神圣伤害，打断非玩家目标施法并使其沉默3秒，接着跳转攻击附近额外的2个敌人。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
荣耀圣令在10秒内额外产生40%的治疗量。

如果在受到有害的持续性伤害效果影响时对自己施放，其治疗效果会提升200%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Word of Glory heals for an additional 40% over 10 sec.

Increased by 200% if cast on yourself while you are afflicted by a harmful damage over time effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在圣盾术期间，15码范围内的所有敌人都会被嘲讽。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: During Divine Shield, all targets within 15 yds are taunted.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 审判会弹射至2个额外目标，效果为50%。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的急速提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your haste is increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Judgment now has 2 charges, and Grand Crusader now also reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫所有魔法伤害和有害效果，持续10秒。

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律效果，持续30秒。

与保护祝福共享冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
如果你为盟友赋予军备，你也会获得其效果。

如果你为自己赋予军备，附近的一名盟友也会获得其效果。

Holy
Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.

 Protection
Consuming Shining Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 复仇之怒额外召唤一把圣洁武器，在复仇之怒期间，你的圣洁武器会对目标施放法术，并模仿你施放神圣能量技能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Avenging Wrath summons an additional Sacred Weapon, and during Avenging Wrath your Sacred Weapon casts spells on your target and echoes the effects of your Holy Power abilities.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的法术和技能有几率为附近的一名盟友显化一件神圣军备。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your spells and abilities have a chance to manifest a Holy Armament for a nearby ally.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
当你或持有神圣壁垒的盟友受到超过最大生命值的治疗时，将100%的过量治疗转移给你的盟友。

当你或持有圣洁武器的盟友生命值低于40%时，立即重新分配你们的生命值，每1秒重复一次，持续4秒。每次施放只能触发一次效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
When you or an ally wielding a Holy Bulwark are healed above maximum health, transfer 100% of the overhealing to your ally.

When you or an ally wielding a Sacred Weapon drop below 40% health, redistribute your health immediately and every 1 sec for 4 sec. May only occur once per cast.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
防护
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的护甲值提高5%，你的主要属性提高2%。

持续1小时。

 神圣
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的护甲值提高5%，你的主要属性提高5%。

持续1小时。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protection
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 2%.

Lasts 1 hour.

 Holy
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 5%.

Lasts 1 hour.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
防护
让圣光凝聚并显化为一件神圣军备，由你的友方目标持有。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protection
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
每施放一次消耗神圣能量的技能，你的下一个奉献会立即造成[(法术强度 * 20 / 10) * (1 + 全能) * 1.19]点伤害，由所有敌人均摊。

最多为附近3名盟友恢复相当于该伤害100%的生命值。

 防护
每施放一次消耗神圣能量的技能，你的下一个奉献会立即造成[(法术强度 * 35 / 10) * (1 + 全能) * 1.15]点伤害，由所有敌人均摊。

最多为附近3名盟友恢复相当于该伤害30%的生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals [(Spell Power * 20 / 10) * (1 + Versatility) * 1.19] damage immediately, split across all enemies.

Up to 3 nearby allies are each healed for 100% of the damage amount.

 Protection
For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals [(Spell Power * 35 / 10) * (1 + Versatility) * 1.15] damage immediately, split across all enemies.

Up to 3 nearby allies are each healed for 30% of the damage amount.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
当你身上的军备消散时，圣疗术的冷却时间缩短15.0秒，并使你获得圣光灌注。

 防护
当你身上的军备消散时，圣疗术的冷却时间缩短15.0秒，并使你获得闪耀之光。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
When an Armament fades from you, the cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced by 15.0 sec and you gain Infusion of Light.

 Protection
When an Armament fades from you, the cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced by 15.0 sec and you gain Shining Light.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你激活的光环对具有你的军备的目标产生的效果提高33%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The effect of your active Aura is increased by 33% on targets with your Armaments.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
防护
当你的神圣壁垒吸收伤害或你的圣洁武器造成伤害或治疗时，你有几率获得大十字军。

 神圣
当你的神圣壁垒吸收伤害或你的圣洁武器造成伤害或治疗时，你有几率获得觉醒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Awakening.

 Protection
When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Grand Crusader.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将圣光精粹铸造成实体武器与护甲，为自己和队友提供圣光圣剑与圣光坚盾。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Crafts pure holy energy into tangible weapons and armor, providing Holy Bulwarks and Sacred Armaments to self and allies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 远古列王守卫拥有1层额外充能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Guardian of Ancient Kings has 1 additional charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
防护
施放神圣军备后，你接下来3次施放的十字军打击会对附近一名盟友施加同类的次级军备。

 神圣
施放神圣军备后，你接下来3次施放的神圣震击或十字军打击会对附近一名盟友施加同类的次级军备。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protection
After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 casts of Crusader Strike bestow a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.

 Holy
After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 casts of Holy Shock or Crusader Strike bestow a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
审判爆击时在目标周围产生冲击波，为至多5名受伤盟友恢复([113.4% of Spell Power])点生命值。

 防护
审判爆击时在目标周围产生冲击波，对5码内的敌人造成([184% of Attack Power])点伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protection
Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, dealing (184% of Attack Power) damage to enemies within 5 yards. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

 Holy
Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, healing to up to 5 injuried allies for (113.4% of Spell Power).

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
防护
圣洁鸣钟会以100%的效果激活槌砧战术。

 神圣
神圣军备会以100%的效果激活槌砧战术。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protection
Divine Toll activates Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.

 Holy
Holy Armaments activate Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
获得先锋效果后，你的下一次正义盾击会对你的主要目标造成100%的额外伤害，并使圣光折射到4个其他目标身上，造成([500% of Attack Power])点神圣伤害。

在复仇之怒期间，你的复仇者之盾总是受益于先锋效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Your next cast of Shield of the Righteous after Vanguard deals 100% additional damage to your primary target and causes light to refract onto 4 other targets for (500% of Attack Power) Holy damage.

During Avenging Wrath your Avenger's Shield always benefits from Vanguard.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 审判造成的伤害提高10%。当你消耗先锋效果时，你获得1点神圣能量。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Judgment deals 10% increased damage. When you consume Vanguard you gain 1 Holy Power.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
审判有几率使你获得先锋效果，使你下一次复仇者之盾在你和初始目标之间的连线上留下一道回响的圣光箭，穿透任何被击中的敌人，造成初始伤害最多150%的伤害。

对次要目标伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Judgment has a chance to grant you Vanguard, causing your next Avenger's Shield to leave an echoing bolt of light in a line between you and the initial target, piercing any enemies for up to 150% of the initial damage dealt.

Damage reduced against secondary targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的 [祝福之锤] [正义之锤 / 十字军打击]会使被击中的敌人对你造成的伤害降低10%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your [Blessed Hammer] [Hammer of the Righteous / Crusader Strike] causes enemies struck to deal 10% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你在奉献范围内，以及离开奉献的4.0秒内，你受到的伤害降低5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While in your Consecration and for 4.0 sec after leaving it, your damage taken is reduced by 5%.
